notes: D6-2: analyzed as a known hypervelocity star at T:p11-b8; no numeric Gaia source ID is supplied. J0546+0836: analyzed at T:p12-b3; the Figure 5 label "J0546" (I:p11-b0) is retained as an alias. J1332-3541: analyzed at T:p12-b2; the Figure 5 label "J1332" (I:p11-b0) is retained as an alias. SDSS J1637+3631: analyzed at T:p12-b5; the Figure 5 label "J1637" (I:p11-b0) is retained as an alias. The conclusion's "SDSS J1637+0836" at T:p13-b8 appears to be a typographical conflation with J0546+0836 and is not treated as an additional identifier or star. The broader hypervelocity-WD sample is inconsistently counted as "seven" at T:p1-b5 and "8" at T:p1-b8, but no other members are individually named in the supplied material, so unnamed group members are not rostered. I treat the paper's hypervelocity-star classification as the Galactic-unbound candidacy basis.

D6-2: No right ascension, declination, distance, parallax, proper motion, radial velocity, galactocentric radius, or bound/unbound probability is reported for D6-2 in the supplied text. The paper reports D6-2's effective temperature, radius, age, and rotation period, but these are not requested quantity identifiers. The velocity at T:p11-b8 is described only as an inferred ejection velocity; the paper does not explicitly state its reference frame, so it is retained under galactic_rest_frame_velocity as the reported total space velocity.

J0546+0836: T:p12-b3 reports an inferred ejection velocity for J0546+0836 (K. El-Badry et al. 2023); the paper does not explicitly state that this is a Galactic rest-frame velocity, but it is the star's total space velocity.

J1332-3541: The paper reports for J1332-3541 only an inferred ejection velocity, plus adopted Teff = 65,657 ± 2,390 K and R = 0.017_{-0.007}^{+0.013} R_sun (T:p12-b2). It does not report RA, Dec, distance, parallax, proper motion, radial velocity, galactocentric radius, or bound/unbound probabilities for this star. The inferred ejection velocity is a total speed, not a line-of-sight radial velocity; I mapped it to galactic_rest_frame_velocity with the caveat noted in the condition.

SDSS J1637+3631: The paper reports SDSS J1637+3631's effective temperature, radius, mass estimates, and flight time at T:p12-b5, but none of these correspond to the requested quantities. No right ascension, declination, distance, parallax, proper-motion components, radial velocity, galactocentric radius, or bound/unbound probabilities are reported for this star. The ejection velocity is the only retained velocity-like quantity; its identification with the Galactic-rest-frame speed is an interpretive step based on the standard HVS usage.
